title.zh: 海关第 2 号修正命令 2017

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Customs (Amendment) (No. 2 ) Order, 2017 , lnsertion of new section 12A into S 39 / 2006

Section 12 of the Customs Order, 2000 in the Order referred to as the principal Order, is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after section 12 "Power of Minister to defer customs duties etc. 12A · ( 1 ) The Minister may, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, by regulations, in relation to dutiable goods imported by any person in the course or furtherance Of any business carried on by him ) provide for the payment of customs duty to be deferred and subject to such requirements and conditions as may be imposed by the Controller; ( b ) permit those goods to be removed from the Ports Department warehouse, customs warehouse or licensed warehouse, as the case m ay bet in accordance with those regulations notwithstanding that the customs duty chargeable on the importation has yet to be paid. ( 2 ) Regulations made under subsection ( 1 ) (a ) m ay provide that such goods may, subject to such requirements and conditions as m ay be imposed by the Controller, (b ) require the person to account fo r and pay the customs duty chargeable on the importation of the goods in such form and manner, within such time and to such person as may be determined by the Controller. " 5127

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE Amendment of section 71

Section 71 of the principal Order is amended (a ) by inserting " ( 1 ) " immediately before "No " in the first line; ( b ) by adding the following new subsection " ( 2 ) For the avoidance of doubt, subsection ( 1 ) does not apply to dutiable goods where the Controller has given permisslon fo r its removal in respect Of which payment of customs duty is deferred in accordance with regulations made under section 12A · Amendment of section 153

Section 153 of the principal Order is amended by inserting "or any regulations made thereunder "immediately after "Order " in the first line. Made this 29th. day of Zulhijjah, 1438 Hijriah corresponding to the 21st. d ay of September 2017 at Our lstana Nurul lman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM Dicetak oleh Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510 Negara Brunei Darussalam. Harga B $ 5 , oo
